StackPosition.helper: Choose which side displays the tall Card 1. Cards 2 and 3 form the two-row stack on the opposite side.

BackgroundColorClass.helper: Optional. Choose a Bootstrap or shared portal background for this full-width section. Text contrast is handled for known dark backgrounds.

CardBackgroundColorClass.helper: Choose a Bootstrap or shared portal background for every card. Text contrast is handled for known dark backgrounds.

AnimationLevel.helper: Controls Porto reveal animation and the strength of hover, shadow, edge, icon-shape, and click feedback. Reduced-motion preferences are always respected.

MarginTop.title: Margin (top)
MarginTop.helper: Optional. Controls spacing above this section.

MarginBottom.title: Margin (bottom)
MarginBottom.helper: Optional. Controls spacing below this section.

PaddingTop.title: Padding (top)
PaddingTop.helper: Optional. Controls inner spacing above the content.

PaddingBottom.title: Padding (bottom)
PaddingBottom.helper: Optional. Controls inner spacing below the content.
